It was 1973. Mike Huckabee, a God-fearing young man from Arkansas, had just
graduated from high school, and his "very wealthy" friend wanted to go on a
celebratory trip. So the pair went to Israel.

"When I was there it was like I was in a place that I felt at home even though
I'd never been there before," Huckabee [said](https://www.ifcj.org/news/yaels-
holy-land-reflections/huckabee-a-conversation-with-a-friend) about his first
trip to Israel, noting he "saw the pioneer's spirit among the Israeli people."

"Part of it, quite frankly, was spiritual for me because here I was in the
land of the Bible for reasons that one day God will reveal, but a land that He
had chosen," he continued. "I think of all the real estate on planet earth, He
picks this little spot of land about the size of New Jersey and says: _This is
mine, right here_."

"And if I wasn't even a believer, I would still come to the conclusion that
the only explanation for Israel is God."

Five decades later, Huckabee, 71, is now the United States' chief
representative to Israel, tasked with negotiating and engaging with the
nation, and protecting Americans if they are ever threatened there. So far,
Huckabee's critics say he's represented Israel's interests as much, if not
more, than America's - and he's done so while
[actively](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=uuCZxvKAhks)
[denying](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=eseP3fP-88o) Israel's genocide in
Gaza, its occupation of Palestine, and its project of apartheid. Meanwhile,
his family's business has continued to take people on pricey tourist trips to
Israel.

The Huckabee family's travel company has taken hundreds of people to Israel
over the years in what used to be
[called](https://web.archive.org/web/20120613181419/http://www.mikehuckabee.com/israelexperience)
"The Israel Experience with Governor Mike Huckabee." Promotional materials and
disclosures reviewed by **Zeteo** show the company, now operated by Huckabee's
son, is still taking Americans on trips to Israel, even as Huckabee serves as
the U.S. ambassador to it.

The situation mirrors, in miniature, how Donald Trump, his family, and some of
his top advisers have - at a
[historic](https://www.rollingstone.com/politics/politics-features/trump-musk-
lawless-second-term-1235290095/), [record](https://zeteo.com/p/trump-scammer-
in-chief-corruption)-[shattering](https://zeteo.com/p/is-this-the-most-
corrupt-administration) rate - cashed in on his presidency, including on
business in the Middle East, with little concern about ethics or the
appearance of corruption.

It remains a brutal irony that Trump was elected again in part due to
depressed voter enthusiasm resulting from the Biden-Harris administration's
[nearly unconditional support](https://zeteo.com/p/progressives-biden-letter-
war-powers-resolution-israel-exclusive) for Israel's genocide in Gaza.

Now, back in power, Trump and his overtly Christian-nationalist and
warmongering administration are not only supporting Israel's constant violence
against Palestine, [as well as Lebanon](https://zeteo.com/p/israels-latest-
invasion-of-lebanon); his top diplomat in Jerusalem, Huckabee, is a genocide
denier who has gone as far as to
[say](https://www.cnn.com/2024/11/12/politics/mike-huckabee-palestinian-
comments-trump-israel-ambassador) there is "no such thing as a Palestinian."
Critics say he has met those words with actions, as he constantly fails
Palestinians and Americans at the behest of Israel.
